verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe launching, monitoring, and orchestrating multiple autonomous agents in parallel across independent projects. Git worktrees isolate those agents in background folders, and cron-scheduled tasks run agents in the background. Nothing documents sustained autonomous runs lasting hours or days, and there is no hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale parallel operation. Missing for 10: documented long-running (hours/days) agent execution, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel fleets.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Orchestrate multiple autonomous agents working in parallel across independent projects.
Have multiple agents working in parallel, so larger tasks get tackled faster.
providing a unified platform to launch, monitor, and orchestrate their activities.
Projects natively support Git worktrees, allowing agents to operate in isolated background folders.
simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.
